qualification.details: Technical Assistant: Graduate or Postgraduate degree in any branch of the Life Science/ Public Health from recognized University/ Institute with minimum of 60% marks. Minimum 1 years of post-qualification experience in research coordination, project management, data management, monitoring & evaluation, or implementation of health/research projects. Experience in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, scientific documentation, report writing, and publication support. Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational skills. Project Associate- I (Medical): Graduate or, Postgraduate degree in any branch of the Life Science/ Public Health from recognized University/ Institute with minimum of 60% marks. Minimum 1 years of post-qualification experience in research coordination, project management, data management, monitoring & evaluation, or implementation of health/research projects. Should be willing to travel for sampling and monitoring studies within Punjab. Project Associate- I (Non-Medical): M.Sc. in Chemistry/Analytical Chemistry or any other specialization with chemistry. Should be willing to travel for sampling and monitoring studies within Punjab.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Bathinda Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Bathinda to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bathinda recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Bathinda recruitment is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Technical Assistant post. The total number of vacancies across all advertised positions is three.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Technical Assistant role?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Graduate or Postgraduate degree in any branch of Life Science or Public Health with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience in research coordination, project management, data management, or related fields is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all the advertised posts is not exceeding 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government/Institute rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Technical Assistant post is ₹30,000/- per month on a consolidated basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the Google Form link provided by AIIMS Bathinda and also submit a hard copy of the application on the interview day.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to upload self-attested scanned copies of all supporting documents with the online application and carry original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies for verification on the interview day.

faq.question: Q10. Where is AIIMS Bathinda located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bathinda is located in Bathinda, Punjab, with the pincode 151001.
